The fine_grained_classifier ranked Airedale #1, but this is likely due to the 'beard' and general terrier shape, ignoring the critical texture/color mismatches. The head structure does not match the 'long, flat, square muzzle' requirement. Only the presence of a beard and general quadruped anatomy aligns. The severe deviation in coat and color warrants a very low alignment score, similar to the 'hammerhead' reference where the subject class was arguably wrong or poorly represented.
